book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: SAN MATEO Jesucristo yee Añurije Quetire Mateo cʉ̃ ca owarique

content: Ca cami boagʉre Jesús cʉ̃ ca catiorique
Ʉ̃tãgʉ ca nii mʉa waari buuropʉ ca niiricʉ Jesús cʉ̃ ca duwi dooro, paʉ bojoca cʉ̃re nʉnʉupa.
Tii tabere jĩcʉ̃ ca cami boagʉ, Jesús pʉto ea, cʉ̃ ãjʉro jupea mena cʉ̃ jʉguero ea nuu waari, o biro cʉ̃re ĩiupi: —Wiogʉ, mʉ ca boojata, yʉ ca boa diarique cʉtirijere yʉre ametʉeneña —ĩiupi.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, Jesús pea cʉ̃ amo mena cʉ̃re padeñari: —Yʉ boo, cami manigʉ tuaya —cʉ̃re ĩiupi. To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩirora, ca cami boamiricʉ jĩcãto cami manigʉpʉ tuacãupi.

To biro tii yapano, o biro cʉ̃re ĩi nemoupi Jesús: —Tʉoya, jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peerena wedeticãña. Díámacʉ̃ra pai pʉtopʉ waari, ĩñoña mʉ ca biiriquere. Ñucã Moisés niiquĩricʉ cʉ̃ ca tiicojo dotiriquere jee waagʉja, paiapʉ cʉ̃ja ca majipere biro ĩigʉ —ĩiupi.
Uwamarã ʉpʉre pade bojari majʉre Jesús cʉ̃ ca catiorique
Jesús, Capernaúm macãre cʉ̃ ca piya nʉnʉa waaro, jĩcʉ̃ romano uwamarã ʉpʉ yʉre tii nemoña ĩigʉ, Jesús pʉto dooupi.
O biro ĩiwi: —Wiogʉ, wiipʉre yʉ paderi majʉ bʉʉcãri, waa majiri méé, ñañaro peti punirije tamʉo niijãwi —cʉ̃re ĩiwi.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, Jesús pea: —Jaʉ. Cʉ̃re yʉ catiogʉ waarucu —cʉ̃re ĩi yʉʉwi.

To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, uwamarã ʉpʉ pea o biro cʉ̃re ĩi yʉʉwi: —Wiogʉ, yʉa, yʉ yaa wiire mʉre ca jãa dotipʉ ʉno méé yʉ nii. Yʉre pade bojari majʉ cʉ̃ ca diarique ametʉape wadore doti cojoya. Yʉre pade bojari majʉ caticoarucumi.

Yʉ cãa, yʉ wiorã cʉ̃ja ca dotirijere ca tiigʉ yʉ nii. Yʉ cãa ñucã, uwamarã yʉ ca dotirije ca tiirãre yʉ cʉo. To biri jĩcʉ̃ cʉ̃ja mena macʉ̃re, “Waagʉja,” yʉ ca ĩiro, waami. Ñucã apĩre, “Dooya” yʉ ca ĩiro, doomi. Yʉre pade bojari majʉ cãare, “Teere tiiya” yʉ ca ĩiro, yʉ ca ĩirore biro tiimi —ĩiwi Jesús're.

Jesús pea atere tʉogʉ, tʉo ʉcʉacoawi. To biri o biro ĩiwi cʉ̃re ca nʉnʉrãre: —Yee méé mʉjare yʉ ĩi: Ano Israel yepare jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peerena ani to cõro bʉaro “Yʉre tii nemocãrucumi,” cʉ̃ ca ĩi tʉgoeña bayirore biro ca biigʉre yʉ bʉa ea ñaati.
To biri paʉ, muipũ cʉ̃ ca mʉa doori nʉña macãrã, cʉ̃ ca ñaajãa waari nʉña macãrã, doori, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob jãa mena, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca doti niiri tabepʉre baa duwirucuma.
Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca doti niiri tabepʉre ca niiboricarã pea,
ca naitĩari yepa pee cõa wiene ecorucuma, oti, cʉ̃ja upi baca dʉpo, cʉ̃ja ca biipa yepapʉre —ĩiwi Jesús.

To biro ĩi, uwamarã ʉpʉ peera o biro ĩiwi: —Tua waagʉja mʉ yaa wiipʉ. “Yʉre catio bojacãrucumi,” mʉ ca ĩi tʉgoeña bayirore birora to biijato —cʉ̃re ĩiwi. Uwamarã ʉpʉre pade coteri majʉ pea to biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiri nimarora caticoaupi.
Pedro mañicõre Jesús cʉ̃ ca catiorique
Jiro Jesús, Pedro yaa wiipʉ waagʉ, Pedro mañicõ wiorique ca dia yojagore bʉa eaupi.
To biro cõ ca biiro, Jesús pea cõ amore cʉ̃ ca padeñarora, wiorique jĩcãto yerijãacoaupa. To biri wãmʉ nʉcã, “¿Mʉja doocãjãri?” cʉ̃jare ĩi jãi boca jʉo waaupo.
Ca diarique cʉtirã paʉre Jesús cʉ̃ ca catiorique

Ca naio doori tabe ca niiro paʉ bojoca ca wãtĩa jãa ecoricarãre jee waaupa Jesús pʉtopʉ. Jesús pea cʉ̃ ca wederije menara yeri ñañarãre cõa wiene, ñucã niipetirã ca diarique cʉtirã cãare cʉ̃jare catio, tiiupi.
Atea Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yee quetire wede jʉgueri majʉ Isaías niiquĩricʉ:

content.text: “Cʉ̃ majuropeera mani ca diarique cʉtirijere jee, puniro mani ca tamʉorijere jee ʉpa, tiiwi,” cʉ̃ ca ĩiquĩrique ca ĩirore biro to biijato ĩiro, bii earo biiupa.

content: Jesús're ca nʉnʉrʉgamiricarã
Paʉ peti bojoca cʉ̃re cʉ̃ja ca nucũ amojodero ĩari, “Ʉtabʉcʉra ape nʉñapʉ mani tĩa waaco,” ĩiwi Jesús.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiri tabera, jĩcʉ̃ doti cũuriquere bueri majʉ cʉ̃ pʉto doori, o biro ĩiwi Jesús're: —Buegʉ, yʉ cãa, noo mʉ ca waari taberi cõro mʉ mena yʉ waa yujurʉga —ĩiwi.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, o biro cʉ̃re ĩi yʉʉwi Jesús: —Buu yairoa
cʉ̃ja ca cãniri operi cʉoma. Minia cãa cʉ̃ja die batiri cʉoma. Yʉ, Ca Nii Majuropeegʉ Macʉ̃ pea, yʉ ca cãniri tabe ʉnora yʉ cʉoti —cʉ̃re ĩiwi.
Ñucã apĩ jĩcʉ̃ cʉ̃ buerã mena macʉ̃ o biro cʉ̃re ĩiwi: —Wiogʉ, yʉ pacʉre yʉ yaa jʉogʉ waarʉga ména —ĩiwi.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, Jesús pea o biro cʉ̃re ĩi yʉʉwi: —Yʉ mena pee dooya. “Ca bii yairã majuropeera cʉ̃ja yaarã ca bii yairãre cʉ̃ja yaajato,” ĩicãña —ĩiwi.
Winore, oco ca jaberijere, Jesús cʉ̃ ca yerijãa dotirique
To biro ĩi yapano, cũmuapʉ ea jãacoawi. Cʉ̃ buerã cãa cʉ̃re jãa nʉnʉ waawʉ.
Too jãa ca tĩa nʉnʉa waaro, ca niiro tʉjarora, ʉtabʉcʉrare bʉaro wino paa puu, bʉaro oco jabe, biima ĩiro, ca duacoaparo cõropʉ cũmuare oco jabe jãawʉ. Jesús pea cãnicoaupi.
To biro ca biiro, cʉ̃ buerã pea o biro cʉ̃re jãa ĩi wãcõrã waawʉ: —Buegʉ, jãare ametʉeneña. Dua waarã mani bii —jãa ĩi acaro buiwʉ.

To biro jãa ca ĩiro, cʉ̃ pea o biro jãare ĩi yʉʉwi: —¿Ñee tiirã to cõro bʉaro mʉja uwiti? ¿“Manire ametʉenecãrucumi,” ĩi tʉgoeña bayiriquere no cõro petoacã peti mʉja cʉocãti? —jãare ĩiwi. To biro jãare ĩicã, wãmʉ nʉcãri, winore, oco ca jaberijere to cõrora yerijãa dotiwi. To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩirora, jĩcãto añuropʉ yerijãa peticoawʉ.

To biro ca biirijere jãa pea ĩa ʉcʉacoari, jãa majurope o biro jãa ameri ĩi jãiñawʉ: —¡Ayó nija! ¿Ñiru ʉno peti cʉ̃ niigajati ania, winopʉra, oco ca jaberijepʉra, cʉ̃ ca dotirore biro añuro ca tʉo nʉnʉjee ecogʉa? —jãa ĩiwʉ.
Pʉarã Gadara yepa macãrã ca wãtĩa jãa ecoricarã

Ʉtabʉcʉra ape nʉñapʉ Gadara yepapʉre Jesús cʉ̃ ca tĩa earo, pʉarã ca wãtĩa jãa ecoricarã, maja operi watoapʉ ca niiricarã ũmaa witi doori, Jesús pʉto eawa. Bʉaro peti uwioro ca tiirã cʉ̃ja ca niiro macã, jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peera tii maare waatirucuupa.
Cʉ̃ja pea o biro ĩi acaro buiwa: —Jesús, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ Macʉ̃, jãare pato wãcõgʉ dooticãña. ¿Tii cuu ca eatirora ñañaro jãare tiigʉ doogʉ anopʉ mʉ doojãri? —ĩiwa.
To biro cʉ̃ja ca ĩi niiri tabe jʉguero jañuro peere ecaricarã yejea paʉ baa niiwa.
To biri wãtĩa pea bʉaro Jesús're o biro ĩi jãiwa: —Jãare mʉ ca cõa wienejata, yejeapʉre jãare jãa dotiya —ĩiwa.

To biro cʉ̃ja ca ĩiro, “Waarãja,” cʉ̃jare ĩiwi Jesús. To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩirora, wãtĩa, ʉmʉapʉre ca niiricarã witi waari, yejeapʉre ñaajãa nʉcã eawa. To cõrora yejea pea, niipetirãpʉra upa tʉdipʉ ũmaa bua waa, ʉtabʉcʉrapʉ ñaañua, dua yai peticoawa.
Yejeare ca cote niiricarã pea to biro ca biirijere ĩa ʉcʉa ũmaa duti tua waa, macãpʉ earã, to biro ca biirique niipetirore, ñucã ca wãtĩa jãa ecomiricarã cʉ̃ja ca biirique cãare wedeupa.

To biro cʉ̃ja ca ĩirijere tʉori, tii macã macãrã niipetirã Jesús cʉ̃ ca niiri tabepʉre ĩarã dooupa. To biri cʉ̃re ĩarã, tii yepare cʉ̃ ca niiro bootirã, “Aperopʉ waacoagʉja,” bʉaro cʉ̃re ĩiwa Jesús're.

footnotes.text: 8.12Judíos, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca jee dica wooricarã peti ca niirã pea ca naitĩari yepa pee cõa wiene ecorucuma.
